subject: Deployment routing impacts on certification and audit timeline
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@mednova.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Quick post-call recap + next steps on hosting options

Hi Aisha —

Thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we can align the compliance path with your audit window: 

- Context: MedNova is evaluating running PHI-bearing inference for the clinician triage product. Primary concerns are BAA, SOC 2 evidence, audit log retention, and network separation.
- Options we discussed (high-level): Hosted API (fastest to prod, limited isolation), Dedicated capacity (reserved GPUs with tenant isolation), Private VPC / on-prem (customer-managed network, max isolation).
- From the call it sounded like your security team will likely prefer Private VPC for production but might accept Dedicated for an internal POC if we can produce a BAA + SOC 2 snapshot and meet logging/retention requirements.

Requested items from your side: 
1) Confirmation of preferred path for POC vs production (Hosted / Dedicated / Private VPC).
2) A target audit date or window so we can prioritize evidence delivery (you mentioned Q3).
3) Any specific data residency or on-prem constraints we should know up front.

We can share our SOC 2 summary and a draft BAA today for your legal/security review — I attached a one-pager on deployment tradeoffs. If helpful, I can loop in Marissa (contracts) and Karthik (infra) for technical detail. 

Proposed next step: 30-min security sync with your security lead early next week to validate the list of evidence and the network diagram requirements. Does Monday or Tuesday work for you?

Thanks,
Logan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: redwood-deploy-options-one-pager.pdf (staged)
From: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@mednova.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: MedNova IT <it-security@mednova.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick post-call recap + next steps on hosting options

Hi Logan —

Appreciate the clear summary. A few clarifications from our side after the call: 

- Production stance: MedNova prefers Private VPC (or fully on-prem) for PHI workloads; that is our long-term requirement.
- POC stance: We are open to running an internal-only POC on Dedicated capacity if we can get a signed BAA and a current SOC 2 report (or summary) showing in-scope controls for logging and key management.
- Audit timing: We have an internal assessment scheduled for the week of 2027-08-09; ideally we need evidence and any architecture diagrams by the end of July to feed into that.

Immediate asks: 
1) Can you send a SOC 2 summary and a draft BAA for review?
2) For Dedicated POC: what network ports and egress controls do you need, and can you provide an initial estimate of latency/throughput we should expect for our average request profile?
3) For Private VPC: what artifact or intake will you need from our network team to produce a network diagram and scoping statement?

I can set a 30-minute slot with our security lead (Sara Patel) — Monday 10:00 AM PT or Tuesday 2:00 PM PT works. Which is better for your team?

Thanks,
Aisha Malik
Director, Product Security | MedNova Health
aisha.malik@mednova.com

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>

Cc: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@mednova.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Quick post-call recap + next steps on hosting options (MedNova)

Marissa / Karthik —

Looping you both in after a discovery with MedNova (Aisha Malik). Summary and asks below — they are PHI, want Private VPC for production, but would accept Dedicated for a POC if we deliver BAA + SOC 2 summary and logging commitments by end of July. Audit window is the week of 2027-08-09.

Actions I think we need from Redwood: 
- Marissa: can you prepare a draft BAA and flag any clauses that will likely need legal redlines? Also include typical timelines for signatures from our side.
- Karthik: can you confirm whether Dedicated capacity can be provisioned for a POC in ~2 weeks and what evidence we can provide quickly (SOC 2 summary, control mapping, audit log retention policy)? Also: what does the Dedicated isolation boundary look like (single-tenant GPU pools? network egress controls?).

Aisha is available for a 30-min security call Monday 10:00 AM PT or Tuesday 2:00 PM PT — please let me know which works so I can confirm.

Thanks,
Logan
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick post-call recap + next steps on hosting options (MedNova)

Thanks Logan —

I've attached a draft BAA and our SOC 2 summary for MedNova to review. High-level notes: 

- BAA: this is our standard template (BAA-template-redwood-v1.docx). I've highlighted the sections where customers often request edits (data return/deletion, subcontractor list, and incident notification SLA). Please expect ~3 business days for minor redline coordination if legal needs to hop in.
- SOC 2: attaching a short summary extract (SOC2-summary-2026.pdf) and a control mapping we can share — this should satisfy an initial security review. Full report is shared under NDA if requested.
- POC path: We can provision Dedicated capacity for an internal POC in approximately 10 business days once a minimal SOW and purchase order are in place. For Private VPC intake we need: network CIDR, VPN endpoint expectations, and a contact for your networking team to coordinate the diagram. 

Proposed mutual action plan (MAP):
1) Today: share BAA + SOC 2 summary (attached).
2) By 2027-05-27: security sync with Sara Patel to confirm checklist and additional artifacts.
3) By 2027-06-10: PO + SOW for Dedicated POC -> provision in ~10 business days.
4) By 2027-07-15: Private VPC intake complete (for teams aiming for production in Q3).

Attachments: BAA-template-redwood-v1.docx (draft), SOC2-summary-2026.pdf (summary), audit-timeline.xlsx (MAP stub)

Drive intake form: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cRedwoodDeploy

Marissa Cole
Senior Contracts Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Note to Karthik: please confirm Dedicated provisioning timeline and whether we can produce the audit log retention policy (S3-retention/30/90/365) as an artifact for MedNova's review.
From: MedNova IT <it-security@mednova.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deployment routing impacts on certification and audit timeline

Logan / Marissa —

Thanks for the quick turn. A few follow-ups from our security operations team after reviewing the SOC summary and draft BAA: 

1) For the POC we are comfortable starting on Dedicated capacity provided we get a signed BAA and confirmation that audit logs (request traces, authentication events, and model invocation metadata) are retained for at least 90 days and can be exported on demand.
2) For production we will require Private VPC with a documented network diagram, VPN/peering requirements, and an agreed-upon plan for key management (KMS/HSM).
3) Please provide a simple network diagram example and an audit-logs retention statement. Also share the minimum list of firewall ports and IP ranges we should expect to open for the Dedicated POC.

We prefer Monday 2027-05-24 10:00 AM PT for the security-only sync (Sara Patel, me from IT, Logan, and Marissa). Please send a calendar invite and an agenda with a short artifact checklist.
